name: token-monitor-hud
description: TokenMonitor inside Claude Code: a band above the prompt with your Claude 5h/7d quota bars, reset countdowns, projection, context fill and session cost — plus your Codex and Antigravity quotas when those CLIs are signed in on this machine. No TokenMonitor device needed.

codex.title: Show Codex
codex.description: Read ~/.codex/auth.json (or $CODEX_HOME/auth.json) and ask chatgpt.com for your Codex quota every 5 minutes. Off: nothing is read or requested.

antigravity.title: Show Antigravity
antigravity.description: Read agy's token from the OS keyring (secret-tool / macOS Keychain) and ask Google for your Antigravity quota every 5 minutes. Off: nothing is read or requested.
